edits.old: - The call type between the client and rwb-agent is **Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0381; ASM-0551)**: this story runs on ASM-0551, the client starts AgentRunWorkflow on queue `rwb-agent` through the P10 contract and reads the run back through `GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-runs`.
edits.new: - The call type between the client and rwb-agent is fixed for this story (GAP-0381; ASM-0551): the client builds the rule result first, starts AgentRunWorkflow on queue `rwb-agent` through the P10 contract with the policy timeout, treats the expiry as TIMED_OUT with the rule result applied, and reads the run, its status and its fallback through `GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-runs`.

edits.old: how the client reaches the workflow and what it reads when the workflow outlives the 60 second budget are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0381; ASM-0551).
edits.new: the client reaches the workflow through the P10 contract, and when the 60 second budget expires it treats the run as TIMED_OUT, applies the rule result and reads the run and its fallback through the same read (GAP-0381; ASM-0551).

edits.old: When a Decision log R holder reads GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId}
edits.new: When a holder of the R right on the decision ledger reads GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId}

edits.old: The client's own route to the agent and its read of the run after the 60 second budget are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0381; ASM-0551).
edits.new: The client reaches the agent by starting AgentRunWorkflow through the P10 contract and, after the 60 second budget, reads the run through `GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-runs` (GAP-0381; ASM-0551).

**Decision entry of an agent step.** The entry carries the decision code in force from LOV-DECISION, read with its version; the fixtures carry "D6". `actions` holds agentRunId, mode, fallback and fallbackReason, and recommendation and finalCall stay separate fields (GAP-1315; GAP-2417). The code of an agent step is settled with the reference-data owner before the first joint environment. The field set of the ledger read answer is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1315).

**Refused record.** A record that rwb-decision refuses is answered with MSG-P7-009 naming the field, is held for the retry and dead-letter path with an alert, and adds nothing to the ledger (GAP-1317).
